response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate AS rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS diff_above_average FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY diff_above_average DESC

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are skipped by SUM(Bytes) in the numerator, but their Milliseconds still count in the denominator, since the request says to use total Bytes and total Milliseconds for tracks linked to a media type. Inner join to MediaType keeps only tracks that have a media type.
Media types are grouped by name. Media types with no tracks are excluded, because they have no rate. The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type rates.
The rate is bytes per millisecond. The division is done in floating point and the results are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Only count tracks that have non-NULL Bytes in both the Bytes total and the Milliseconds total, so the rate is not biased down by tracks with NULL Bytes.
alternatives.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate AS rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS diff_above_average FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY diff_above_average DESC
